## Type of change

- [ ] **Feature:** new behaviour

- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] A change to the stored session bumps its schema version and adds a migration.
- [ ] A change to recipe timings or oven logic bumps `PIZZA_CONTENT_VERSION`.
- [ ] UI changes were checked in light and dark, at phone width.
